verdict.rationale: Security and compliance posture is a fair question for a cloud GPU compute provider like Modal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only GPU selection, pricing, environments, SDKs and observability. Nothing in it addresses SOC 2, data-handling policies, datacenter tiers or a trust center.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
